subject: Request: elevated latency safeguard & MSA/order-form exhibit for HIPAA deployment
messages:
From: Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@vigilanthealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vigilanthealth.com, Tim Jansen <tim.jansen@vigilanthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: elevated latency safeguard & MSA/order-form exhibit for HIPAA deployment

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Vigilant is preparing to onboard a HIPAA-sensitive workflow that will rely on synchronous inference for patient triage. Before we proceed to procurement, our security and procurement teams have two asks we need Redwood to confirm in writing: 

1) A custom availability exhibit for the MSA that includes an exception path for a high-availability (dedicated) deployment with an elevated uptime commitment and a measurable latency safeguard (we're looking for p95 latency SLAs on sync endpoints).

2) Order-form language (or an addendum) that maps the exhibit to the order form (so the dedicated capacity SKU for the deployment carries the SLA). We also need the evidence path you will provide for uptime/latency (dashboards, monthly reports, and audit artifacts).

Attached: Vigilant_Procurement_RFI.pdf (procurement security questionnaire excerpt).

Can you share a redline for the exhibit and a suggested sentence for the order form by COB Nov 12? We have a procurement review on Nov 16 and need to bundle your response with our MSA redlines. If you want, we can do a short call Thursday (Nov 6) to walk through the edge cases (fallback to hosted models, regional failover).

Best,
Sara Lyle
Senior Procurement Manager
Vigilant Health Systems
(attachment: Vigilant_Procurement_RFI.pdf)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@vigilanthealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: elevated latency safeguard & MSA/order-form exhibit for HIPAA deployment

Sara — thanks for the clear asks. We can support a tailored approach for regulated workloads. High level options we can propose now: 

- Option A (Dedicated capacity): Availability exhibit with 99.95% monthly uptime, plus a "latency safeguard" clause committing p95 request latency < 250ms for defined sync endpoints when traffic remains within the provisioned capacity.
- Option B (Dedicated + burst): 99.9% uptime with automatic regional fallback and a best-effort latency target (p95 < 350ms); includes documented fallback behavior and longer notice windows for scheduled maintenance.

Evidence & controls we will offer: 
- Monthly uptime and latency report (token-level and route-level breakdown)
- Dashboard access to per-route tracing and p95 graphs (read-only link)
- SOC 2 type II report and KMS attestations for key material handling (for Private deployments we also offer on-prem attestation statements).

I'm attaching a first-pass availability exhibit and an order-form redline that maps the exhibit to a dedicated SKU and shows a sample credit schedule. These are draft — we can tighten numbers after internal alignment.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Quick alignment call: Nov 6 at 10:00 AM PT (30 min).
2) We finalize redline and deliver to you by COB Nov 12.

Attachments: redwood-draft-availability-exhibit.docx; redwood-orderform-latency-safeguard-redline.docx

I'll loop legal and product folks on follow-ups. Ben/Laura/Monica — can you review the attached exhibit and confirm whether the p95 250ms is achievable for the dedicated path and whether the credit schedule aligns with our standard order-form templates?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-draft-availability-exhibit.docx)
(attachment: redwood-orderform-latency-safeguard-redline.docx)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Vigilant — proposed exhibit & order form language (need quick checks)

Team — short internal thread so we have a paper trail for procurement. Key items I want confirmed before we send a tightened redline: 

- Performance target: Is p95 < 250ms (for sync / low-context requests) realistic on Dedicated at the committed capacity profile? If not, suggest alternate numbers and a short justification paragraph.
- Evidence path: Laura pls confirm what we can reasonably commit to for the order form (dashboard access, monthly PDF report, and a one-time uptime attestation for initial on-boarding).
- Compliance artifacts: Monica pls confirm SOC2/ISMS note we can include and whether we can offer KMS HSM integration language in the exhibit.
- Credit mechanics: Ben pls confirm the credit table I sketched in the attached doc — specifically the mapping of minutes of downtime to % credit for the month for a 99.95 vs 99.9 band.

Draft latency safeguard clause (very rough):
"For Dedicated Capacity subscriptions governed by this Order Form, Redwood warrants that, while Customer traffic remains within the provisioned capacity and the Dedicated pool is healthy, the p95 request latency for designated synchronous inference endpoints will not exceed 250 milliseconds. In the event of a breach, Customer may be eligible for Service Credits per the attached credit schedule. Exceptions: scheduled maintenance (with notice) and documented force majeure events will not be considered breaches."

Please review the attached redwood-draft-availability-exhibit.docx and give short replies (thumbs-up / edits) by EOD today — Sara's procurement team wants the call notes and a bedrock redline.

Rafael
(attachment: redwood-draft-availability-exhibit.docx)

From: Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@vigilanthealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vigilanthealth.com, Tim Jansen <tim.jansen@vigilanthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: elevated latency safeguard & MSA/order-form exhibit for HIPAA deployment

Rafael — thanks for the fast turnaround and for proposing both options. We had a quick internal review and two clarifications/requests before we lock numbers: 

1) Evidence: we need explicit language in the order form that Redwood will provide a monthly latency and uptime report with route-level p95 numbers and tokenized examples for three production routes for the first three months post-launch. Can you include that in the exhibit?

2) Credit schedule: Vigilant's legal prefers a slightly more generous credit for the first 90 days of the onboarding (we're willing to accept 99.95, but ask for a 75% credit cap during initial onboarding if SLA not met). This is a limited-term carving to help cover potential production risk during our go-live window.

We reviewed Option A and are happy to proceed down that path if Redwood can add the monthly report clause and the temporary increased credit cap for the onboarding window. Attached are our MSA redlines to help align definitions (Vigilant_MSARedlines_20261105.pdf).

Let's take the Nov 6 call at 10 AM PT to finalize language. Also: here's a shared folder with our evidence checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF_shared_evidence

Thanks — Sara
(attachment: Vigilant_MSARedlines_20261105.pdf)
